name: Engine R1: Three-only core (remove Pixi, one effects schema, stage space, three layer on a render target)
description: Turns the engine Three-only: deletes the Pixi 2D stage and pixi-filters code, unifies filters and postFx into one effects list, adds the pixel stage space and the Three versions of the node contract and base transform, moves the post-processing chain to engine/src/effects with output into a render target, and rewrites the three layer to render into a render target on the single renderer. Ends with a Three-only smoke page.

readFirst: engine/docs/README.md (Pixi → Three table, decisions D8 to D11, build plan)
engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md sections 'Stage space', 'The MotionNode contract', 'Base transform', 'Visibility'
engine/docs/04-three.md and engine/docs/05-effects.md sections 'The effect table' and 'The chain'
engine/docs/port-map.md (status column: what is kept, rebuilt, deleted)
engine/src/core/*, engine/src/schema/*, engine/src/timeline/targets.ts, engine/src/three/** (built in M1, M2, M4, M6)
extraGuardrails: Before starting, confirm the archived engine PRDs M1, M2, M4 and M6 are done and committed (ralph/prd-m1-foundation.json, prd-m2-timeline.json, prd-m4-three.json, prd-m6-postfx.json all passes true) and `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass; if not, set notes to 'blocked: base engine not committed' and stop.

The goal is Three.js and GSAP only. Do not add, keep or write any import of pixi.js, pixi-filters, @pixi/* or @react-three/* under engine/. pixi.js stays installed only because the director app uses it.

Deleting Pixi-era engine code is expected in this PRD (engine/src/pixi, engine/src/filters, engine/src/three/offscreen.ts, engine/src/three/postfx, engine/fixtures/filters-2d.json). Keep every other existing test green or update it to the new names in the same story.

stories.title: Delete the Pixi 2D stage and pixi-filters code; move visibility to core
stories.description: As an engine developer, I want the Pixi-era 2D and filter code gone so that nothing in the engine depends on Pixi except the two files later stories rewrite.
steps: Read engine/docs/README.md (Pixi → Three table) and engine/docs/port-map.md (status column), then list engine/src/pixi, engine/src/filters and every file that imports from them (grep).
Move engine/src/pixi/visibility.ts and its test to engine/src/core/visibility.ts (same function, same tests) and export isVisible from engine/src/core/index.ts.

Delete engine/src/pixi/ (all files), engine/src/filters/ (all files) and engine/fixtures/filters-2d.json; remove any import of them elsewhere (only engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx and engine/src/three may still import pixi.js after this story; they are rewritten in US-005 and US-006).
Run npm run typecheck and npm test and fix only breakages caused by the deletion.
acceptance: engine/src/pixi and engine/src/filters no longer exist and engine/fixtures/filters-2d.json is gone
isVisible is exported from engine/src/core and its moved tests pass (isVisible(6, 0, 6, 6) is true, isVisible(2, 1, 2, 6) is false)
`grep -rlE "from ['\"](pixi\.js|pixi-filters)" engine/src engine/lab` lists only engine/src/core/types.ts, engine/src/core/transform.ts, engine/src/three/threeNode.ts and engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx

stories.title: Schema: one effects list replaces filters and postFx; effect:<id> targets; no skew
stories.description: As an author, I want one effects list on every layer and on the doc, with one target form, so that 2D and 3D effects are written the same way.
steps: Read engine/docs/01-schema.md (Layer base, three, Effect, Cross-field rules), engine/docs/05-effects.md (Effect types table with the Where column) and engine/docs/02-timeline.md (Target paths), then engine/src/schema/enums.ts, parts.ts, layers2d.ts, layer3d.ts, doc.ts and engine/src/timeline/targets.ts.

In enums.ts replace FILTER_2D_TYPES and POSTFX_TYPES with EFFECT_TYPES (the 18 types of the table) plus EFFECT_SCOPES (type → 'any' | 'three' | '2d'); in parts.ts replace Filter2DSchema and PostFxSchema with EffectSchema { id, type, enabled = true, params: Record<string, number | string> = {} }.

Rename the layer field filters to effects (2D layers), replace postFx with effects on three layers, rename the doc field filters to effects; add the cross-field rule: dof only on three layers, glow/dropShadow/outline only on 2D layers, doc-level effects only of scope 'any'; effect ids unique per list.

In engine/src/timeline/targets.ts replace the filter: and postfx: target forms with effect:<id> (allowed on every layer kind, id must exist in that layer's effects) and remove skewX and skewY from the base layer props.

Update the four fixtures in engine/fixtures to the new field and target names with types from the new list (keep the same intent), fix compile errors in engine/src/three caused by the renamed types (behaviour unchanged), and update the existing schema and targets tests.
acceptance: A text layer with effects [{ id: 'g', type: 'glow' }] parses with enabled true; a three layer with a glow effect fails with a path ending in .effects[0].type; a 2D layer with a dof effect fails
A doc with effects [{ id: 'v', type: 'vignette' }] parses and a doc-level outline effect fails
A tween with target 'effect:g' on that text layer passes validateTargets; 'filter:g' and 'postfx:g' are errors; 'skewX' is no longer an allowed base property

All four fixtures parse and validateTargets returns no errors for them; `grep -rnE "postFx|Filter2D|FILTER_2D_TYPES|POSTFX_TYPES" engine/src engine/fixtures` prints nothing outside engine/src/three/postfx

stories.title: Stage space and the Three base transform (display/content groups, proxies, blending)
stories.description: As an engine developer, I want the pixel stage mapping and a Three version of the layer transform so that every node places, rotates, scales and fades the same way.
steps: Read engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md sections 'Stage space' and 'Base transform', engine/src/core/transform.ts (the Pixi version) and tmp/reacthub-pixitweenjs/src/utils/blendMode.ts.

Move the current Pixi functions of engine/src/core/transform.ts unchanged into engine/src/core/legacy-pixi-transform.ts (used only by the old threeNode until US-005 deletes both) and point engine/src/three/threeNode.ts and its imports at it.
Create engine/src/core/stage.ts with createStageCamera, toWorldY, toWorldRotation and configure2DMaterial as specified.

Rewrite engine/src/core/transform.ts on Three: createLayerObjects, applyBaseTransform(display, content, layer, size), resolveBaseTarget(node, prop) with the proxy allowlist x, y, alpha, rotation (deg), scale, scaleX, scaleY, and blendingFor(mode).
Write engine/src/core/stage.test.ts and replace engine/src/core/transform.test.ts with Three-based tests.
acceptance: createStageCamera(1920, 1080) has left 0, right 1920, top 0, bottom -1080; toWorldY(100) is -100

applyBaseTransform for { x: 100, y: 50, rotation: 90, scale: [2, 3], anchor: [0.5, 1] } and size 40x20 gives display.position (100, -50, 0), display.rotation.z -Math.PI / 2, display.scale (2, 3, 1) and content.position (-20, 20, 0)

Writing 30 through resolveBaseTarget(node, 'y') sets display.position.y to -30 and reading it back returns 30; writing Math.PI / 2 through 'rotation' sets rotation.z to -Math.PI / 2; 'skewX' returns null
blendingFor('add') gives blending AdditiveBlending; blendingFor('screen') gives CustomBlending with blendSrc OneFactor and blendDst OneMinusSrcColorFactor

stories.title: Effect table and chain in engine/src/effects with output into a render target
stories.description: As an engine developer, I want one effect table and chain builder that can render into a render target or the canvas so that 3D layers, isolated 2D layers and the stage share it.
steps: Read engine/docs/05-effects.md sections 'Effect types', 'The effect table' and 'The chain', engine/src/three/postfx/effects.ts and chain.ts (built in M6), and check CopyPass, KawaseBlurPass, SepiaEffect, ColorAverageEffect, PixelationEffect, ScanlineEffect, DotScreenEffect, TiltShiftEffect in node_modules/postprocessing/build/types/index.d.ts.

Create engine/src/effects/table.ts with EffectDef and EFFECTS for every type of scope 'any' and 'three' in the table (port the 7 M6 definitions, add sepia, grayscale, pixelate, scanlines, dotScreen, tiltShift, blur); custom 2D effects are added by R3.

Create engine/src/effects/chain.ts with buildEffectChain({ renderer, scene, camera, effects, size, output, toneMapping }) as specified (RenderPass, optional KawaseBlurPass, one EffectPass with ToneMappingEffect last when toneMapping, CopyPass(output) when output is a target, fast path with no effects and no tone mapping, toneMapping swapped to NoToneMapping during render and restored on throw, render(0)) and setEffectChainFactoryForTests(fn | null).

Create engine/src/effects/index.ts and tests table.test.ts and chain.test.ts (vi.mock('postprocessing') for pass order, like the M6 tests). Leave engine/src/three/postfx in place; US-005 switches threeNode over and deletes it.
acceptance: EFFECTS has an entry for every type of scope 'any' or 'three' in engine/docs/05-effects.md, and every tweenable key round-trips through set and get (or writes the documented field for mocked classes)
With output set to a render target the composer's passes end with a CopyPass constructed with that target; with output null there is no CopyPass
With effects [] and toneMapping false, render() calls renderer.setRenderTarget(output) and renderer.render(scene, camera) and creates no EffectComposer
With toneMapping true the EffectPass ends with a ToneMappingEffect in ACES_FILMIC mode, and renderer.toneMapping is restored after render even when the composer throws

stories.title: ThreeNode on a render target; Three node contract; delete offscreen pool and postfx
stories.description: As an engine developer, I want the three layer to render into a render target on the player's one renderer and show it on a plane so that 3D lives inside the Three stage with no Pixi and no second WebGL context.
steps: Read engine/docs/04-three.md sections 'How it draws' and 'ThreeNode', engine/docs/03-stage-2d.md 'The MotionNode contract', and the current engine/src/three/threeNode.ts and its tests.

Rewrite engine/src/core/types.ts to the Three contract in 03-stage-2d.md (display THREE.Object3D, alpha, applyOpacity, update(t, frame), warnings; NodeContext with textures THREE.Texture and renderer).

Rewrite engine/src/three/threeNode.ts as specified: display/content from core/transform, a WebGLRenderTarget of width x height, a plane with MeshBasicMaterial({ map: target.texture, transparent: true, toneMapped: false }) through configure2DMaterial, a chain from buildEffectChain with output target and toneMapping true, effect:<id> routed to the chain, applyOpacity on the plane, update(t, frame) doing mixers, lookAt, fov and chain.render; renderer null uses the test chain factory.

Make getRoomEnvironmentTexture cache per WebGLRenderer with a WeakMap; delete engine/src/three/offscreen.ts and its test, engine/src/three/postfx/ and engine/src/core/legacy-pixi-transform.ts; update engine/src/three/index.ts and engine/src/core/index.ts exports.
Rewrite engine/src/three/threeNode.test.ts with renderer null and setEffectChainFactoryForTests.
acceptance: createThreeNode with renderer null and a fake chain: resolveTarget('object:b', 'rotation.y') is kind 'deg', resolveTarget('effect:glow', 'intensity') comes from the fake chain, resolveTarget('object:zz', 'scale') is null
update(1, 30) calls the fake chain's render once; applyOpacity(0.5) sets the plane material opacity to 0.5
destroy() disposes the render target, the plane geometry and material and the rig (spied)
engine/src/three/offscreen.ts, engine/src/three/postfx and engine/src/core/legacy-pixi-transform.ts no longer exist and `grep -rlE "from ['\"]pixi" engine/src` prints nothing

stories.title: Three-only smoke page: a three layer on the stage, tweened with GSAP
stories.description: As a project owner, I want to see a 3D layer draw and move on the new Three-only stage before the 2D nodes and runtime exist so that rendering problems show up now.
steps: Read the current engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx, web/motion-three-smoke.html, web/src/dev/three-check.tsx (hashCanvas) and engine/docs/06-runtime-player.md (MotionRuntime renderer settings).

Rewrite engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx without Pixi: a WebGLRenderer with the runtime settings (pixel ratio 1, sRGB output, NoToneMapping, preserveDrawingBuffer, shadows), a stage Scene with background #224466 and createStageCamera, a select between three-primitives, three-gltf and three-postfx; preloadThreeAssets, createThreeNode with renderer, add its display; a paused gsap.timeline tweening object rotation.y and camera position.z through resolveTarget.

Add a seek slider (timeline.seek(t); node.update(t, frame); renderer.render(stage, camera)), the canvas hash after each seek, the RGBA of the canvas pixel 5 px inside the layer's top-left corner, and the node's errors and warnings.
Open http://localhost:5173/motion-three-smoke.html, check all three fixtures, seek to the same time twice, save screenshots to debug/engine/.
acceptance: The robot in three-gltf is visible, lit, standing on its shadow, and its pose differs between seek 0.5 s and 1.5 s
Seeking 2.0 s, then 0, then 2.0 s shows the same hash both times at 2.0 s
On three-postfx the corner pixel readout equals the stage background #224466 within 2 per channel (the transparent layer stays transparent) and bloom is visible on the can
No errors on the page or in the console for any of the three fixtures, and engine/lab/three-smoke.tsx imports nothing from pixi

stories.title: Fence: lint forbids Pixi in engine/; exports updated
stories.description: As a project owner, I want the build itself to reject any Pixi import in the engine so that it can never creep back in.
steps: Read eslint.config.js (the engine/** block added in M1) and engine/src/core/index.ts, engine/src/effects/index.ts, engine/src/three/index.ts.
Extend the engine/** no-restricted-imports block with pixi.js, pixi-filters and @pixi/* (patterns), message 'The engine is Three.js only (engine/docs/README.md).'
Check that core, effects and three index files export the new public API (stage helpers, transform, types, visibility, EFFECTS, buildEffectChain, createThreeNode) and nothing that no longer exists.
Run npm run lint, npm run typecheck and npm test.
acceptance: eslint.config.js forbids pixi.js, pixi-filters and @pixi/* under engine/** (a temporary file engine/src/tmp-check.ts importing pixi.js fails npm run lint; delete it afterwards)
`grep -rniE "pixi" engine/src engine/lab` prints nothing except comments that mention the library name reacthub-pixitweenjs
npm run typecheck, npm test and npm run lint pass
